title: HelperFSWriteCommitParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's write-commit op: install one session's temporary file, but only over the version the caller expected. The path must remain in the directory write-open resolved — the name may differ, which is how a KeepBoth collision is answered without sending the bytes again — and anything that escapes that directory is refused `invalid-path`. The size is the caller's own count of what it sent: a session holding another number answers `size-mismatch` and stays open, which is the cheap check that catches a chunk the caller believed delivered.

id.description: The session id write-open was given.

path.description: The absolute path to install at. Its directory must resolve to the one write-open resolved; its final component may name another file in that directory.

size.description: The number of bytes the caller believes it wrote. It must equal the session's own count, or the commit is refused `size-mismatch`.

expect.description: The condition the target must still satisfy. Omitted or empty means no condition: the temporary replaces whatever is at the name. Its two members are ALTERNATIVES — a request carrying both is refused `bad_params`, because two conditions at once mean the caller has not decided what it wants.

version.description: What a whole-file read answered: the target must still have this size, this mtime and this digest, or the commit is refused `changed-since-read`. Size and mtime are the cheap fields; the digest is what survives a rewrite of the same length inside one filesystem timestamp granule.

absent.description: True asks that nothing exist at this name: an occupied name answers `exists` and nothing is replaced. False says nothing at all, and is refused `bad_params`.
